purpose: Verifies the non-production UAT Spring profile loads the dev-uat Flyway migration path and seeds the shared customer/admin test login.
businessRules: The shared UAT login is testuser@gmail.com.
The shared UAT OTP is exactly 123456.
The shared test account is enabled for both customer and admin flows.
The shared test account is projected into customer_accounts and customer_auth_identities.
Seeded admin roles cover SUPER_ADMIN, CHANGE_SUBMITTER, CHANGE_REVIEWER, and CHANGE_MANAGER.
